# Hazelden Betty Ford Foundation

> A comprehensive addiction treatment and mental health organization offering inpatient and outpatient care, graduate education, research, and professional training across multiple U.S. locations.

Hazelden Betty Ford Foundation is a leading nonprofit organization specializing in substance use disorder and mental health treatment. The organization operates treatment facilities across multiple states (Minnesota, California, Oregon, Florida, Illinois, New York, Washington, Wisconsin), offers accredited graduate programs in addiction studies, conducts research through the Butler Center, and provides professional education and consulting services to healthcare providers and communities.

## Key Topics

- Addiction treatment
- Substance use disorders
- Mental health services
- Outpatient treatment
- Addiction counseling
- Professional training
- Graduate education
- Patient assessment
- Insurance verification
- Continuing education
- Behavioral health
- ASAM criteria
- Prevention consulting
- Clinical internships
- Recovery support

## Treatment & Admissions

- [Substance Abuse Recovery & Mental Health Treatment](https://www.hazeldenbettyford.org): Hazelden Betty Ford Foundation homepage for addiction treatment and mental health services.
- [Admissions | Hazelden Betty Ford](https://www.hazeldenbettyford.org/admissions): Admissions process, intake assessment, and treatment options at Hazelden Betty Ford.
- [Refer a Patient for Drug or Alcohol Rehab at Hazelden Betty Ford](https://www.hazeldenbettyford.org/referrals): Patient referral process and professional collaboration for addiction treatment placement.
- [Insurance for Drug and Alcohol Rehab | Hazelden Betty Ford](https://www.hazeldenbettyford.org/insurance): Insurance coverage, verification, and financial assistance information for rehab.
- [Contact Hazelden Betty Ford: Call or Email Us for Help](https://www.hazeldenbettyford.org/contact): Contact information for treatment, graduate school, publishing, and medical records.

## Education & Training

- [Graduate School | Hazelden Betty Ford](https://www.hazeldenbettyford.org/graduate-school-addiction-studies): Master's programs in addiction counseling and healthcare certificates from Hazelden Betty Ford Graduate School.
- [Addiction Counseling Courses | Professional Development Courses](https://www.hazeldenbettyford.org/graduate-school-addiction-studies/professional-development-courses): Professional development and continuing education in addiction counseling from Graduate School.
- [Psychology Internships | Hazelden Betty Ford](https://www.hazeldenbettyford.org/professionals/mental-health-internships): Clinical practicum, doctoral internship, and postdoctoral psychology residency programs.
- [Addiction Treatment Information for Medical Professionals](https://www.hazeldenbettyford.org/professionals/medical-professional-education): Medical education programs and resources for healthcare professionals in addiction treatment.
- [Learning](https://discover.hazeldenbettyford.org/learning): On-demand training courses and professional development in substance use disorders.

## Professional Resources & Research

- [Butler Center for Research | Hazelden Betty Ford Foundation](https://www.hazeldenbettyford.org/research-studies): Butler Center for Research advancing knowledge of addiction, treatment, and recovery.
- [Professional Relations Team | Hazelden Betty Ford](https://www.hazeldenbettyford.org/professionals/professional-relations-team): Professional relations team contacts for healthcare provider referrals and treatment consultation.
- [Addiction Prevention Solutions for Communities | Hazelden Betty Ford](https://www.hazeldenbettyford.org/professionals/consulting-training/prevention): Addiction prevention consulting, training, and community intervention resources.
- [ASAM Criteria and Levels of Care](https://discover.hazeldenbettyford.org/asam-criteria): ASAM assessment criteria and treatment level guidelines for addiction care.
- [Behavioral Health Resource Center](https://discover.hazeldenbettyford.org/content/publishing/behavioral-health-resources.html): Digital behavioral health resources and evidence-based clinical tools and curricula.

## Ongoing Support & Community

- [Thought for the Day | Daily Meditation | Hazelden Betty Ford](https://www.hazeldenbettyford.org/thought-for-the-day): Daily meditations and reflections from recovery books for ongoing support.
- [In-person and Online Events | Hazelden Betty Ford](https://www.hazeldenbettyford.org/events): Recovery-centered events and professional training hosted throughout the year.

## Optional

- [Donations | Hazelden Betty Ford](https://www.hazeldenbettyford.org/ways-to-give): Donation opportunities to support Hazelden Betty Ford's substance use and mental health services.
- [Careers Home](https://jobs.hazeldenbettyford.org): Job portal for healthcare and counseling positions across Hazelden Betty Ford locations.
